semantic_units.text: The PAD MUX block serves to route source-specified functional, scan, BIST, debug, and ISPU-debug signals to and from device pads.
The PAD MUX block accepts Mode selection, register-map controls, test controls, and internal block outputs.
The PAD MUX block produces Pad controls, test observations, and routed internal signals.
In function mode, the GPIO1,2,3,4 output is i time slot irq if sel irq gpi1,2,3,4 is 0x05 and ext cap en is “0” and i error time slot if sel irq gpi1,2,3,4 is 0x04 and ext cap en is “0”.

In function mode, the GPIO1,2,3,4 out is i LED Pilot if sel irq gpi1,2,3,4 is 0x02 and ext cap en is “0”, General-Purpose if sel irq gpi1,2,3,4 is 0x00 and ext cap en is “0”, irq fifo if sel irq gpio1,2,3,4 is 0x01 and ext cap en is “0” and i DCCK irq if sel irq gpi1,2,3,4 is 0x03 and ext cap en is “0”.
